answer_1.quote: The goal of this task is to generate RNA sequences that specifically bind to a target RBP, conditioned on contextual labels including the target RBP (P target ) and either the associated cell type (C cell ) or species (S species ).
answer_1.outputs: RNA sequences that specifically bind to a target RBP under biological constraints

answer_2.quote: We assess generation quality using two custom metrics: Weighted Success Rate (WSR) and Metric Similarity.
